convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for SilverTrend and ColorJFatl_Digit indicators (custom indicators), plus external .mqh libraries for money management (CMMRec) and digital signal processing. Complex money management with recovery logic.

other_exits: Money management recovery module may close positions based on equity drawdown rules

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CMMRec money management: negative input=fixed lots, positive input=fraction of deposit. Recovery logic adjusts lot size after consecutive losses.

custom_logic_notes: SilverTrend is a signal indicator producing buy/sell signals. ColorJFatl_Digit is a digital-filtered moving average that changes color based on trend direction. Entry requires both indicators to confirm. CMMRec (Money Management with Recovery) adjusts position sizing dynamically based on account equity and consecutive loss recovery algorithm. The 'Digit' suffix indicates digital signal processing filters (JFATL = Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line with digital filtering). SL/TP values are subject to 10x multiplication on 5-digit/3-digit brokers.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of SilverTrend and ColorJFatl_Digit custom indicator logic in Python - these are not standard indicators. The CMMRec money management with recovery logic must also be ported. Digital signal processing (JFATL/Jurik filters) will require numpy/scipy implementation. Digit adjustment (5-digit broker SL/TP*10) must be handled in Python by checking symbol decimal places. The EA uses previous bar values [1] for signal confirmation - ensure lookback indexing is correct in pandas.
